90.alt: Torobo by Tokyo Robotics, full body, carrying sacks, on its base
90.identity: Tokyo Robotics' official page image torobo_move_task, with the Torobo name on the page: the whole platform carrying sacks, with its payload and grippers. The record is Torobo (mobile-manipulator configuration in the product brochure).

101.alt: Quanta X2 by X Square Robot, full body, on its wheeled base
101.credit: Image: X Square Robot, Quanta X2
101.identity: Navigation illustration of X Square Robot's Quantum 2 product page (the Quanta X2), the robot alone isolated from the scene. Alpha by Claude from a BiRefNet mask of the original (kept beside it), replacing a cutout that removed the dark face and kept a scan-grid line. The record is Quanta X2 (dexterous-hand configuration).

193.alt: Bolt by MirrorMe, full body, front view, standing in its 03 kit
193.identity: Official Bolt product page image people-bolt.png: the complete biped wearing the 03 kit; not the quadrupeds on the same page. Alpha by Claude: the lower of a BiRefNet mask and the original's own transparency, which removes a dark haze in the arm gap. The record is Bolt.

197.alt: DEX-M by Richtech Robotics, full body, two arms on its wheeled chassis
197.identity: Official DEX product page render dex-trimmed-4.png, which corresponds to DEX-M on the mobile wheeled chassis, not ADAM or the fixed DEX-S. The record is Dex (mobile chassis); the caption names DEX-M.

139.alt: H2 by Unitree, full body, front view, standing in a fighting stance
139.identity: Official Unitree H2 page image (a still of the robot outdoors). Alpha by Claude from a BiRefNet mask of the original (kept beside it), replacing a cutout that lost the raised arm and kept a spectator between the legs. The record is H2 and H2 EDU; no edition is attributed.

141.alt: R1 by Unitree, full body, running
141.identity: Official Unitree R1 page image of the robot running on grass, both feet visible. Alpha by Claude from a BiRefNet mask of the original (kept beside it), without the grass fringe. The record is R1, R1 AIR and R1 EDU; no edition is attributed.

40.alt: AEON by Hexagon, full body, side view, on wheels, still from the official animation
40.identity: Frame 105 (4.2 s at 25 fps) of Hexagon's official product animation On-Wheels.mp4, 1280 × 720: the whole AEON on wheels. It is an official animation still, not a hardware photograph. The record is AEON with wheeled mobility.
40.quality: Animation still at native size: 209 × 517 px as prepared, not enlarged.

97.alt: Calvin-40 by Wandercraft, full body, front view, without end effectors
97.credit: Image: Wandercraft, Calvin-40 without end effectors
97.identity: Wandercraft's official Calvin page, front view whose file name reads calvin-05-front-no-end-effector: the whole robot, which has no head by design, shown without end effectors. The record is Calvin-40; nothing is added (no head, no hands).

207.alt: Zerith H1 by Zerith Robotics, full body, side view, on its wheeled column
207.identity: Zerith's official H1 product page image img_201.png: the whole robot in side view on its wheeled column, with base, hands and head; not the cropped torso cards. The record is Zerith H1.

198.alt: REX G1 by RoboScience, full body, front view, on its wheeled chassis, still from the official product video
198.credit: Image: RoboScience, REX G1 video still
198.identity: Frame 0 of RoboScience's official REX-G1 product video, whose title card names REX G1 beside the robot (an existing manufacturer video still, not a new rendering): the whole wheeled humanoid with both hands and the entire chassis and wheels. The title, logo, backdrop and ground shadow are excluded by the alpha mask. The record is REX-G1.
